name: fomo-sapiens
title_zh: 在 fomo.family 上边看盘边写研报的加密交
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口，就能查代币、读 thesis、看仓位、下 Solana/EVM 单。
tagline_en: Check tokens, read theses, view portfolio & swap on Solana/EVM without leaving fomo.family. For when a meme coin.
desc_en: Fomo Sapiens — research, trade, and write theses on fomo.family (social crypto trading app). Market/token research, thesis analysis, portfolio, deposits, and live trading (Solana + EVM swaps). Use when the user mentions fomo, fomo.family, trading memecoins, thesis feeds, or their fomo portfolio.
why_zh: 把交易前的研究、下单向和事后复盘收进同一条工作流，且直接长在 fomo.family 的社交流里——不…
why_en: It collapses pre-trade research, execution, and post-trade notes into one flow that lives inside fomo.family's social feed — a.
limit_zh: 只认 fomo.family 生态：代币/帖子/仓位必须来自该平台，外部链上数据需自行导入。不负责做最终涨跌判断。
limit_en: Only works within fomo.family: tokens, posts & positions must come from the platform; external on-chain data needs manual import. No price.
title_en: Research, trade & write theses on fomo.family
